future_diagnostic_boundary: A separately versioned and pre-frozen diagnostic could use an explicit terminator or finite indexed sequence to investigate stopping/counting behavior. Such a diagnostic cannot repair, replace, or rescore these immutable cells.

independent_classification.actual_8k_acceptance: supported: all six requests received complete streamed responses, endpoint usage reported at least 8192 prompt tokens, and request-specific canaries passed
independent_classification.harness_counting_or_capture_bug: not proven: source strips only the leading marker, counts exact body words, rejects extras, and artifacts report complete non-truncated captures far below the 8192-character bound
independent_classification.model_error_claim: not established beyond observed failure to follow the frozen output instruction
independent_classification.performance_eligibility: none: zero of six requests is eligible and aggregate throughput/latency distributions are correctly withheld
independent_classification.shared_root_cause: unresolved: identical 493-word length-capped behavior is suspicious but does not distinguish shared model-family repetition, template/runtime stop behavior, or prompt-induced continuation dynamics
independent_classification.strict_128_output_adherence: failed: all six responses continued to the 512-token limit and contained 493 code words instead of exactly 128
independent_classification.usable_context_qualification: not established: request acceptance and a canary do not prove full-context comprehension or satisfy the controlled-output cell

permitted_use_of_current_cells: evidence that the endpoints accepted and responded to actual approximately-8K prompts
evidence that strict controlled-output adherence failed
prohibited_use_of_current_cells: retroactive waiver or reinterpretation of the strict output gate
causal attribution to a model, runtime, tokenizer, template, or harness bug

reviewed_harness_source.failure_policy: Any strict controlled-output failure retains bounded sanitized response metadata but is excluded from all performance distributions.
reviewed_harness_source.prompt_contract: Begin response with the exact request marker followed by one space; then emit exactly 128 repetitions of lowercase code separated by single spaces; add no other text and do not stop early.
reviewed_harness_source.strict_validator_contract: Marker must be at byte zero, no foreign ANVIL_REQ marker may occur, visible capture must be complete, body must contain exactly 128 code words and zero other words.

scope: Read-only audit of immutable baseline4B and Qwen3.5-9B capacity artifacts, dry-run commands, offline calibration, and reviewed prompt/stream/validator source. No inference, lifecycle, host operation, tests, or product edits.
